 Initiate and track required HR processes and notifications through KEKA.
 Maintain employee records, documentation, attendance-related information, and separation records as assigned.
 Ensure timely and accurate HRMS data updates.
 G. Exit & Separation Formalities 
 Coordinate employee resignation and separation processes.
 Ensure employees complete required exit formalities and documentation.
 Coordinate with reporting managers and concerned departments for clearance and handover.
 Initiate and update separation formalities in KEKA.
 Coordinate asset handover, department clearance, and other exit requirements.

 Conduct or coordinate exit interviews and maintain relevant records.
